correctness.native_prefill_logits_sha256: exact match between legacy and candidate
correctness.dynamic_gate_decisions: exact match for every layer and region
correctness.core_token_ids: exact ordered IDs for every layer and region; no local Top-K approximation
correctness.region_statistics: mean/p95/max use the original definitions; absolute error <= 1e-6
correctness.core_aggregation: normalize each complete causal query row first, then average heads and query positions
correctness.static_gate: core-only path preserves ordered IDs exactly

performance.design: locked GPU, independent process per run, at least three paired repetitions, native/A/B measurements with identical input and backend

candidate_gate.native_attention_replacement: not allowed unless separately proven faster

performance.low_overhead_claim: allowed only if candidate dynamic-minus-native overhead <= 10% of native full prefill at 32K/64K/128K; otherwise report the measured value without claiming low overhead

candidate_comparison.A: independent legacy region and core profiling
candidate_comparison.B: one shared tail attention normalization producing both region mass and core scores
candidate_comparison.C: native LSE plus bounded mass recomputation plus required core scan
candidate_comparison.selection: choose B if C does not outperform B after the complete core-token cost is included

hygiene: GPU memory.used < 500 MiB and no compute process before launch; external nvidia-smi monitoring throughout; polluted runs are invalid
